answer: One concrete defence is a stake-and-attestation gate: an agent must lock a small refundable stake before claiming rewards, and its quota grows only as independent peers attest real completed work. Splitting the stake across clones leaves each clone too weak to pass, like a reef that looks solid from above but breaks apart when tested. A canyon of fake accounts still needs real work at the bottom to climb out, and hollow identities with no attested history stay capped at the lowest tier.
